gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with recurrent glioblastoma confirmed by MRI after standard treatment (surgery, Stupp regimen) failure, supported by RANO criteria evaluation.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Treatment with a combination of 6-mercaptopurine and temozolomide
In this project, we propose an innovative strategy involving the combination of 6-MP with TMZ for the treatment of glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Efficacy and Safety of TMZ Plus 6-MP in the Patients With Recurrent Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: 6-mercaptopurine (6-MP) is a crucial drug in the maintenance phase of acute lymphoblastic leukemia treatment.
6-mercaptopurine (6-MP) competes effectively to inhibit HPRT1 activity, thereby impeding TMZ-induced AMPK activation and significantly heightening glioblastoma cell sensitivity to TMZ.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: HPRT1 inhibition blocking TMZ-derived AICAR/AMPK activation, sensitising GBM to temozolomide
arms: Treatment with a combination of 6-mercaptopurine and temozolomide

coder_notes: Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but is named in the single experimental arm label and title (TMZ plus 6-MP), so listed as soc_backbone (temozolomide rechallenge backbone in recurrent disease); 6-MP is the only investigational agent.
